title: Rolando Whole House Remodel
summary: Comprehensive renovation and expansion of a 1942 single-family residence, including a substantial rear addition, redesigned living spaces, a new primary suite, and an elevated redwood deck. The project included complete permit drawings, structural coordination, and construction documentation.
projectDetails: 553 sq ft of existing home remodeled
New primary bedroom suite with walk-in closet
New primary bathroom and powder room
Expanded kitchen with large island and pantry
Five Solatube skylights providing natural daylight
Structural coordination for hillside deck and foundations
highlights: Large rear addition integrated with the existing home
Spacious primary suite with modern amenities
Open-concept kitchen, dining, and family living
Elevated redwood deck overlooking the rear yard
Natural daylight enhanced with five Solatube skylights
Complex hillside and retaining wall coordination
